calls.statement:
SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week 
WHERE store_key = 30 
  AND product_key = 11
  AND week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'

SELECT 
  s.store_name,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  fsw.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store s ON fsw.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON fsw.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON fsw.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 124
  AND p.sku = 100011
  AND fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
